name: Elmera
source:
Childhood friend of Aruji. She runs a general store. Reunites with Aruji when he comes to Valleroy on a task. Possessing information about many things, she assist Aruji. She's the energetic type who loves to fuss over others.

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/character05.php]official website[/url]]
